title: GTA 6 Got 8 Game Awards Nominations Before Launch
caption:
Real: The Game Awards announced its 2026 nominees on 17 Nov, two days before GTA 6 launched, and GTA 6 leads with 8, including Game of the Year. It faces 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem and Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Winners on 10 Dec.
Does GTA 6 deserve Game of the Year?

Sources: The Game Awards via Gematsu, Dexerto
ig_first_line: 8 nominations for a game nobody could buy yet. GTA 6 leads The Game Awards 2026.
